I saved Pree's correction in the knowledge brain: the deadline for the signed order form at Tansley Parcel is 3 April. The note says this replaces the date she posted in #central-team this morning. Then I replied to her message in #central-random to say I'd noted it.

As she asked, I took no other action. I didn't open #central-team or edit her earlier post. In my reply I suggested she post a quick correction in #central-team, since that's where people saw the wrong date.
